# Pixarrow — Comprehensive Knowledge Graph & System Blueprint
> Canonical reference for LLM search agents, AI engines, and enterprise web crawlers.

## Company Overview
Pixarrow is an elite digital growth and web engineering studio founded by Anuj Sharma (CTO) and Ankit Rajput (CSO). Pixarrow specializes in architecting sub-second Next.js 16 platforms, headless eCommerce storefronts, high-throughput mobile applications, and performance marketing engines.

- **URL**: https://pixarrow.com
- **Headquarters**: Mohali, Punjab, India
- **Global Reach**: Serving clients across US, Australia, UK, Europe, UAE, and India
- **Contact**: hello@pixarrow.com | +917973060924 | https://pixarrow.com/book
- **Primary Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, NestJS, Fastify, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS CloudFront, Cloudflare R2, React Native, Shopify Plus Hydrogen.
- **Key Guarantee**: Signed NDA in 24h, 15-Day Quality Guarantee.

## Core Practice Areas & Solutions

### 1. Next.js 16 & Full-Stack Web Development
- Sub-0.7s LCP with zero client hydration penalty using React Server Components.
- Edge rendering, dynamic streaming, and stale-while-revalidate ISR caching.
- Custom API microservices built on Fastify, NestJS, and Prisma/PostgreSQL.
- Learn more: https://pixarrow.com/services/nextjs-development

### 2. High-AOV eCommerce & Headless Shopify Plus
- Headless Shopify Plus architecture with Hydrogen & Next.js.
- Custom 1-click checkout extensions, real-time inventory syncing, and zero plugin bloat.
- Conversion-optimized UI/UX with bespoke 60fps micro-animations.
- Learn more: https://pixarrow.com/services/ecommerce-growth-engineering

### 3. Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Apps
- React Native & Flutter mobile engineering for iOS and Android.
- Offline-first architecture, background push notification systems, Stripe & Apple Pay integrations.
- Learn more: https://pixarrow.com/services/mobile-app-development

### 4. Agentic AI & Autonomous Automations
- Autonomous LLM workflows, custom AI customer service agents, vector search RAG systems.
- Enterprise API orchestration and automated lead enrichment.
- Learn more: https://pixarrow.com/services/agentic-ai-automations
